allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Part-time model Valentine unexpectedly befriends a retired judge after she runs over his dog. At first, the grumpy man shows no concern about the dog, and Valentine decides to keep it. But the two form a bond when she returns to his house and catches him listening to his neighbors’ phone calls.

visibleEditorialCopy.description: After accidentally injuring a dog, part-time model Valentine meets its detached owner, a retired judge. When she discovers he routinely eavesdrops on his neighbors, an improbable connection begins to form.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, deliberate, and emotionally resonant French drama laced with quiet, voyeuristic mystery.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Krzysztof Kieślowski crafts an intimate, slow-burning drama that folds quiet suspense and genuine emotional warmth into an unconventional moral encounter.
